evidence_basis: release metadata and text annotations only; no video or feature tensors inspected

interpretation.inherited_negative_use: Exact v3 negative rows can be reused as inherited v3 annotations after per-group semantic reclassification and leakage checks, while carrying their original provenance unchanged.
interpretation.not_visual_verification: The status llm_semantic_review_passed and absence_evidence string do not establish absence from video; construction_protocol.json explicitly says video_review_performed=false and the README says no per-video review was performed.
interpretation.new_candidate_status: New reassignment and counterfactual rows are candidates only; textual absence of matching positives is an open-world heuristic and cannot become an exist_label=0 gold annotation without video verification.
interpretation.source_reference_edge_case: Three source_qid values do not resolve to the clean v3 positive pool. Preserve the references and flag them; do not silently repair by guessing or discard provenance.

requirements: source query expresses intended held-out key
target's full available annotation set has no direct equivalent positive
record lexical similarity score and method as TF-IDF/token-overlap surrogate if CLIP unavailable
start from a genuine positive query
change one non-target role or event component only
preserve the exact frozen action-role-filler key and direction
reject if changed candidate key differs
screen all same-video positive events and multi-event structures

existing_matched_u_pairs.interpretation: These are within-video minimal-edit source/candidate pairs, not Moment-of-Untruth-style cross-video reassignment. Keep these construction mechanisms labeled separately.
existing_matched_u_pairs.note: The C1_v3 and C2_v3 files are legacy group-specific matched pair indexes; only reuse when the exact source/candidate rows still qualify for a newly frozen target key.

independent_conclusion: There is a substantial inherited negative pool and it can provide useful text-level U- coverage for composition groups where existing negatives express the held relation. However, under the available evidence, no new candidate can be called a visually confirmed absence. Reassignment and compositional counterfactual expansion are feasible only as separately labeled candidate sidecars pending video review.
